evidence: Redesigns CScriptWitness and CTxIn primitives and script execution data structures to eliminate validation-time memory and CPU DoS.
rationale: Eliminates a significant validation-time DoS vector where crafted 4 MB blocks with millions of empty witness elements allocate over 110 MB of RAM and require hundreds of milliseconds to deserialize. Benchmarks demonstrate allocated memory drops from 112 MB to 4.0 MB and deserialization latency drops from 346 ms to ~16 ms.
